Pursuant to the agreement, STWI agreed to acquire 99.99999012% of the membership interests in TEG SPV from the Sellers in exchange for an aggregate of 183,098,434 shares of STWI common stock (the "Exchange Shares"), 124,506,935 of which Exchange Shares were to be issued to the reporting person; and 58,591,499 of which Exchange Shares were to be issued to Ms. Irodakhitova (the "Share Exchange Transaction").
